title: The 209 Event
description:
The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located and beautifully decorated triplex, sleeping up to 15! Fully equipped with 3 kitchens, 3 bathrooms, and 8 beds. Perfect for your big event in Nashville!

The space
The 209 Event is three separate apartments in the same building. You will get the entire building.

The first apartment has two king beds and a full pullout couch. The second has two queen beds. The third has a king bed, full size bunk and a queen pull out. All three have one bathroom, full kitchen and living area.
